title: stichorkis janowskii
intro: Stichorkis janowskii, commonly known as the Janowskia orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stichorkis janowskii include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
